#Spotlight: A new case of HMPV infection has been reported in Mumbai city, taking India's total number of cases to 8. An outbreak of the infection in northern China prompted alarm after videos on social media showed hospitals overrun with masked people. 
@alysonle tells you more. https://t.co/t1WAjJX9H5
